profile.headline: Talented and versatile software engineer
profile.summary: Passionate software engineer on the endless pursuit of knowledge, innovation, and sweet cutting-edge tech. Expertise in full-stack application development utilizing agile methodologies. I live to build.

positions.title: C2000 Failure Analysis Lab Intern
positions.description: Tested optimal chip operation speeds under extreme temperatures, drafted microchip pin-out verifications, and performed general lab maintenance. Gave presentations, worked on prototype boards for testing chips, and developed systems in LabView to simplify lab procedures.

positions.title: CAD Draftsman
positions.description: Reformatted and edited AutoCAD drawings and schematics for high voltage substations both in and out of the Houston area. Preformed on-site substation evaluations and corresponding “AS-BUILT” drafting for record keeping and liability assurance. Redrafted previously existing substations in order to implement technology for new digital voltage meters for households.
